verdict.rationale: Gladia is API-first: core transcription in both async and live modes, plus features such as PII redaction, translation, diarization, custom vocabulary, sentiment and subtitle export, is documented as request parameters. An official CLI and MCP server add further programmatic access. The browser Playground is framed as a place to test features before integrating, which implies the API offers the same features, but no parity statement exists. Account-level UI functions like credit top-up and the model-comparison arena have no documented API equivalent, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account/billing/dashboard functions, and a published OpenAPI spec or independent corroboration.
